# DetailHeader

The top of a detail screen — a meal, a recipe or a dinner party: optional avatar and eyebrow, meta line, serif title, summary, fact badges and up to two action…

`NomNom.DetailHeader` · Content

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.DetailHeader title="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.DetailHeader" title="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (DetailHeaderProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` * | `string` |  |
| `eyebrow` | `string` | Uppercase category above the title (recipes). |
| `meta` | `string` | Above the title; below it when there is an eyebrow or avatar. |
| `summary` | `string` |  |
| `avatar` | `AvatarProps` | Rendered at size 'xl' unless given. |
| `facts` | `string[]` | Badges, variant 'secondary' by default. Metadata about the subject — time, method, servings. Joined with " · " into one tertiary line, not chips. |
| `badges` | `BadgeProps[]` | The few things that are a status rather than a fact: Staple, Pro, Archived. Badge props. |
| `actions` | `AppButtonProps[]` | Up to two; rendered lg, sharing the row. One solid action per header. |
| `align` | `'start' \| 'center'` | @default 'start' |
